offering_description.value: Sells cloud-based payroll, human capital management and workforce software to mid-sized employers in the United States. Delivered as a subscription platform with implementation and support services.

primary_products.value: payroll software; HR management software; talent management software; time and labor software; benefits administration software

primary_services.value: payroll processing; tax filing and compliance; implementation services

customer_segment.value: B2B: mid-sized private employers across many industries

end_markets.value: human resources; payroll; professional services; healthcare; manufacturing; retail

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring fees for software modules, paid per employee per month; service fees: implementation, training and payroll tax filing services; interest or premiums: interest earned on client funds held between payroll debit and payment
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts its own cloud HR and payroll platform, sold to employers; service provider: runs payroll processing and tax filings for employer clients

geography_served.value: US national: serves employers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: payroll, HR, talent, time and benefits modules sharing one platform and customer base

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales team selling to employers; partners / resellers: referral and integration partners such as accounting and benefits firms; online: self-service platform used by client employers and employees

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payroll tax filing and money movement rules, plus data privacy and security requirements

notes: Company is described from general knowledge; current module lineup and revenue mix may have changed.
